laws.title: Wahlgesetz des Landes Sachsen-Anhalt (LWG)
laws.citation: LWG in der Fassung der Bekanntmachung vom 18. Februar 2010 (GVBl. LSA S. 80), zuletzt geändert durch Artikel 2 des Gesetzes vom 19. März 2021 (GVBl. LSA S. 98); Sec. 1, 32, 33, 35 unchanged in substance up to the Gesetz vom 7. Februar 2025 (GVBl. LSA S. 316)

steps.title: Sum the whole tally to level of its main hierarchy, e.g
Elect one nominee in each unit of level by method, from the valid votes in section summed over channels (Urne and Brief)
Sum the whole tally to level of its main hierarchy, e.g
The parties that pass threshold on their valid votes in section, summed at level, become eligible
The chamber has seats seats to begin with, e.g

Allocate the seats of the chamber size with protocol (the rules from the seat total to the list seats, usually one StepSequence); then, while a party holds Mehrsitze (overhang), raise the chamber_size and allocate again

children.title: allocate the seats of one chamber size
The seats the proportional allocation divides
Apportion seat_total among the eligible parties by method, on their valid votes in section summed at level
Deduct each eligible party's Wahlkreis seats from its entitlement

laws.title: Gesetz über die Wahlen im Land Mecklenburg-Vorpommern (Landes- und Kommunalwahlgesetz - LKWG M-V)
laws.citation: LKWG M-V vom 16. Dezember 2010 (GVOBl. M-V S. 690), Fassung gültig vom 1. September 2026 bis 31. Dezember 2028, zuletzt geändert durch Artikel 12 des Gesetzes vom 8. Juli 2026 (GVOBl. M-V S. 719, 731); Sec. 54, 57, 58 unchanged since 1 January 2011

steps.title: Sum the whole tally to level of its main hierarchy, e.g
Elect one nominee in each unit of level by method, from the valid votes in section summed over channels (Urne and Brief)
Sum the whole tally to level of its main hierarchy, e.g
The parties that pass threshold on their valid votes in section, summed at level, become eligible
The chamber has seats seats to begin with, e.g

Allocate the seats of the chamber size with protocol; then, while a party holds Überhang (overhang), raise the chamber_size one seat at a time and allocate again, until every party's entitlement covers its Wahlkreis seats

children.title: allocate the seats of one chamber size
The seats the proportional allocation divides
Apportion seat_total among the eligible parties by method, on their valid votes in section summed at level
Deduct each eligible party's Wahlkreis seats from its entitlement
